create_IterGraphModule: create an IterGraphModule from an fx.GraphModule to enable cross-iteration graph optimization across setup, main, and cleanup graphs
move_subgraph_to_next_iter: move a subgraph of fx.Nodes to the next iteration before a target node in an IterGraph for cross-iteration optimization
freeze_cross_iter_movement: freeze cross-iteration movement in an IterGraph or IterGraphModule to prevent further graph rewrites
recompile_IterGraphModule: recompile all three GraphModules (setup, main, cleanup) in an IterGraphModule after graph modifications
print_all_IterGraphs: print the three fx.Graph representations (setup, main, cleanup) of an IterGraphModule for debugging
